proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#3
proposed.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Storm, Cyclops and Wolverine, but Storm stops the missiles he launches.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old friend, whose missiles Storm stops.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man who stops his missiles.

changes.evidence: In 'Enter Magneto' (XTAS #3), Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine confront Magneto at the Drake missile base; he assumes they came to join him, easily disables all three and sends a message to Xavier. Storm then flies after the launched missiles and, guided by Xavier, short-circuits them and drops them into the water. They meet and clash here, long before the X-Men '97 #2 stage, so the connection starts at #3 as enemies.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#3
proposed.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Wolverine, Cyclops and Storm and sends them back to Xavier with a message.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old friend, who easily beats Logan at a missile base.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man Magneto easily beats at a missile base.

changes.evidence: In 'Enter Magneto' (XTAS #3), Magneto easily disables Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine at the Drake missile base and gives them a message for Xavier. In XTAS there are more direct moments later: in 'Family Ties' (#58) Xavier sends Wolverine to watch Magneto, and Magneto helps free him from the High Evolutionary, and in 'Beyond Good and Evil' Magneto frees Wolverine first from Apocalypse's prisoners. So the connection starts long before X-Men '97 #9.
